steps.say: Lofgren syndrome is bursting forth as an acute self-limiting triad. Bilateral hilar nodes with acute migratory ankle periarthritis are joining erythema nodosum. Spontaneous remission is following in more than 80 to 90 percent. Ankles with nodes and shin nodules are predicting cure.

steps.say: Heerfordt syndrome is burning as uveoparotid fever in rare cases. Anterior uveitis with parotid enlargement and low-grade fever is forming three quarters. Seventh nerve facial palsy of lower motor neuron type is completing the tetrad on one or both sides. Eyes with glands and drooping faces are marking Heerfordt.

steps.say: Scadding staging is sorting chest films from Stage 0 to Stage IV in five steps. Normal films are sitting at Stage 0 while hilar nodes alone are filling Stage I. Nodes with infiltrates are sharing Stage II while infiltrates alone are holding Stage III. Fibrotic honeycombing with volume loss is closing Stage IV. Films are marching from nodes to fibrosis.

steps.say: Calcium metabolism is running wild in 10 to 20 percent of patients. Hypercalcemia is appearing in 10 percent with hypercalciuria in 30 percent. Macrophage 1-alpha-hydroxylation of 25-hydroxyvitamin D into 1,25 calcitriol is driving the excess. Parathyroid control is bypassed entirely. Granulomas are brewing vitamin D on their own.

steps.say: Cardiac sarcoidosis is killing quietly with blocks and rhythms. High-grade atrioventricular block with malignant ventricular tachyarrhythmias is striking without warning. Congestive cardiomyopathy is following the scars toward sudden death. Patchy epicardial enhancement on cardiac MRI is revealing the scars. Active inflammation is glowing on 18F-FDG PET-CT. Scars are enhancing while inflammation is glowing.

steps.say: Systemic steroids are leading therapy for threatening disease. Oral prednisone 20 to 40 mg daily is calming cardiac, neurologic, ocular, calcium, and lung disease. Methotrexate 10 to 20 mg weekly with azathioprine or infliximab is sustaining refractory or maintenance care. Steroids are leading while methotrexate is sustaining.
